featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

Sports Injury Treatment in Jogeshwari — How to Recover Safely and Get Back to Activity

Sports injuries can affect athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and even individuals who engage in regular physical activity. While some injuries may seem minor initially, ignoring them can lead to prolonged pain and delayed recovery.

The first step after a sports injury is proper evaluation and diagnosis. Rest, ice application, compression, and elevation may help reduce pain and swelling in the early stages. However, persistent pain, difficulty moving a joint, instability, or recurring injuries should be assessed by a medical professional.

A structured recovery plan is essential for safe healing. Depending on the severity of the injury, treatment may include medication, physiotherapy, rehabilitation exercises, or advanced orthopaedic care. Returning to sports too early can increase the risk of re-injury and further damage.

Fracture Treatment Near Jogeshwari — A Complete Patient Guide for Faster Recovery

A fracture, commonly known as a broken bone, can occur due to falls, sports injuries, road accidents, or sudden trauma. While some fractures are obvious and cause severe pain, others may present with swelling, bruising, tenderness, or difficulty moving the affected area. Seeking prompt medical attention is essential to ensure proper healing and prevent complications.

The first step in fracture treatment is an accurate diagnosis, usually through a physical examination and imaging tests such as X-rays. Depending on the type and severity of the fracture, treatment may involve casting, splinting, medication, physiotherapy, or surgery. Following your doctor's instructions carefully is crucial for a smooth recovery.

Patients can support healing by getting adequate rest, maintaining a nutritious diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, and avoiding activities that place stress on the injured bone. Rehabilitation exercises may also be recommended to restore strength, flexibility, and mobility after the fracture begins to heal.

Back Pain in Jogeshwari — When Home Remedies Are Not Enough and a Doctor Is Needed

Back pain is one of the most common health complaints and is often caused by poor posture, muscle strain, prolonged sitting, or heavy lifting. While mild discomfort may improve with rest, stretching, and home remedies, persistent or severe back pain should not be ignored.

If your back pain lasts for more than a few weeks, keeps returning, interferes with daily activities, or becomes worse over time, it may indicate an underlying condition that requires medical attention. Symptoms such as pain radiating down the legs, numbness, tingling, weakness, or difficulty standing and walking should be evaluated by a specialist as soon as possible.

Common causes of chronic back pain include slipped discs, arthritis, spinal degeneration, nerve compression, and sports or workplace injuries. Early diagnosis can help prevent complications and improve recovery outcomes.

ECG Test in Jogeshwari — What It Detects and Why Doctors Recommend It

An Electrocardiogram (ECG) is one of the most commonly recommended heart tests and plays an important role in evaluating heart health. The test records the electrical activity of the heart and helps doctors identify potential cardiac problems quickly and non-invasively.

Doctors may recommend an ECG if a patient experiences symptoms such as chest pain, palpitations, shortness of breath, dizziness, or unexplained fatigue. The test can help detect irregular heart rhythms (arrhythmias), signs of a previous heart attack, reduced blood flow to the heart, and other abnormalities that may affect heart function.

An ECG is also commonly used as part of routine health screenings for individuals with high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, or a family history of heart disease. Early detection of heart-related issues allows for timely treatment and better long-term outcomes.

If you are experiencing heart-related symptoms or have risk factors for cardiovascular disease, consulting a cardiologist in Jogeshwari can help determine whether an ECG is required. Heart Checkup in Jogeshwari Who Needs It and How Often Should You Go?

Many heart conditions develop gradually and may not show clear symptoms in their early stages. That's why regular heart screenings are important, especially for individuals with risk factors such as high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, obesity, smoking, or a family history of heart disease. Consulting a cardiologist in Jogeshwari can help detect potential heart problems before they become serious.

A heart checkup is also recommended for people experiencing chest discomfort, shortness of breath, dizziness, heart palpitations, or unexplained fatigue. Adults over the age of 40 should consider periodic cardiac evaluations, while those with existing health conditions may require more frequent monitoring based on their doctor's advice.

Routine tests such as blood pressure monitoring, ECG, cholesterol screening, and other cardiac assessments can provide valuable insights into your heart health. Early diagnosis allows for timely treatment and lifestyle modifications that may help prevent future complications.

featured_reviews.name: ABDUL ALIM ANSARI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my heartfelt appreciation to KJ Cure Hospital for the excellent care and outstanding service provided. The staff is highly professional, attentive, and genuinely committed to patient well-being. The quality of treatment is exceptional, and the overall environment is clean, comfortable, and reassuring.

A special thanks to Dr. Hifjurrehman Mohammad Kasam, who is truly an outstanding doctor. His expertise, kindness, and dedication made a significant difference in our experience. He takes the time to listen, explains everything clearly, and ensures the best possible care for his patients.

On behalf of my mother, Mrs. Tajjalh Begum Abdul Hakim Ansari, we extend our sincere gratitude and best wishes to the entire hospital team. We are deeply thankful for the care and support we received.

Highly recommended to anyone seeking the best medical treatment and compassionate care.

featured_reviews.name: mnhs kdr
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently underwent ACL reconstruction along with a medial meniscus repair at this hospital, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the care I received. A special thank you to Dr. HifjurrRahman and his entire team for their professionalism, skill, and constant support throughout the process.

Three years ago, my younger brother had his full ACL reconstruction done here as well, and his excellent recovery is one of the main reasons we trusted Dr. HifjurrRahman again. Just like my brother’s experience, my surgery went incredibly smooth. From the pre-surgery consultations to post-operative care, everything was handled with clarity, patience, and genuine concern.

Dr. HifjurrRahman is not only highly skilled but also very reassuring, which made a huge difference during such a stressful time. The staff were always attentive, kind, and ready to help with any questions or concerns.

Today, I’m back on my feet and getting stronger every day and it’s all thanks to Dr. HifjurrRahman and his amazing team. I truly recommend this hospital to anyone needing orthopedic care. You’ll be in the best hands.

featured_reviews.name: Air Ip
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was admitted to KJ Cure Hospital for an operation, trusting that I would be in safe and professional hands. What I experienced instead was nothing short of horrifying and completely unacceptable.

To begin with, this hospital doesn’t even have a proper ICU facility. Despite this, they assured us that everything was under control and that sufficient oxygen would be arranged for the procedure. We were repeatedly told there was “nothing to worry about.”

However, mid-operation, there was an actual shortage of oxygen.

This created sheer panic among my family members and caused immense mental stress and trauma—something no patient or family should ever have to go through, especially during a critical medical procedure. This is not a small oversight; it is a life-threatening failure.

The staff is highly unprofessional and appears to be underqualified, with little to no understanding of how to handle patients or critical situations. Instead of experienced doctors, the environment feels like it is being run by inexperienced individuals who are not equipped to deal with real medical responsibilities.

This level of negligence, false assurance, and lack of basic medical infrastructure is beyond unacceptable for any hospital. It raises serious concerns about patient safety and ethical responsibility.

I strongly advise others to think twice before trusting this institution with something as important as their health or the health of their loved ones.

featured_reviews.name: veer poojari
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr. Hifzur Rehman is very cool. His treatment is next level. I had a rib fracture, and at that time he treated me without surgery and helped me recover. I have never met a doctor like him till now. I would suggest that if there are any injuries in your family or friends, you should go to him—he will take care of it.

featured_reviews.name: Ali Akbar Chowhan
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an excellent experience at KJ Cure Hospital. The physiotherapy department is outstanding—very professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. The physiotherapists took the time to understand my condition and tailored the treatment accordingly, which made a noticeable difference in my recovery. The staff was supportive, and the overall environment was clean and well-organized. I highly recommend KJ Cure Hospital, especially for anyone seeking quality physiotherapy care.

featured_reviews.name: Amreen
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and stressful experience. I was advised admission by a diabetologist and I confirmed bed availability beforehand, but on arrival, no bed was available and I was asked to shift later.
During my stay, care was unprofessional. During an ABG test at midnight, the physician (Sharif Ansari) behaved rudely and mishandled the procedure, due to which I faced severe complications like intense shaking and severe electric shock-like symptoms all over the body,my bp went extremely low.
Due to poor treatment, after 2 days I opted for DAMA discharge. At the time of discharge, my condition suddenly worsened,my body started swelling ,sugar sand I am unaware of what medication was given. It felt like there was an attempt to push me towards ICU admission for higher billing, while blaming me for the discharge.
Billing was highly unreasonable—₹1500 charged for gloves and ₹1500 for disposables like cotton and needles, despite not seeing proper usage,bed charge is expensive for which fan was not working,ac was leaking,no iv stand,saline grip was hanged on curtain hook.Staff response was extremely slow, and behavior of junior doctor Nagma was also unprofessional.
I strongly warn others—this hospital may add unnecessary charges for treatments and items not actually provided. Overall, very poor care, lack of transparency, and unethical practices.

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: I took my aunt to this hospital for her arthritis, which was initially affecting only her left leg. What we experienced there was extremely disappointing and concerning. Instead of being treated by experienced doctors, most of the care was handled by very young interns who clearly lacked the expertise required for such a condition. The treatment they provided did not improve her condition but in fact, it made things significantly worse. What started as a problem in one leg has now spread to both legs, increasing her pain and suffering. This is not just negligence, it is outright irresponsible medical handling. The staff is highly unprofessional and seems completely unprepared to deal with patients requiring proper care and attention. There is a clear lack of experience and accountability. I would strongly advise others to think twice before trusting this hospital with serious medical conditions.

featured_reviews.name: Anjuman Ghori
featured_reviews.review_text: “I had my knee surgery done by Dr. Hifjur Rehman at KJ Cure Hospital, and my experience was excellent. The treatment and services were outstanding. The staff is बेहद caring, and a special thanks to Nagma for being so wonderful and supportive during my entire journey. And my wife started walking very next day we are very happy with the doctor and kj team 😀

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Chandwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Rajshree is incredibly supportive - her calm and healing way of communicating made the whole surgery process much easier. She explains everything with so much patience and support. Hats off to her Energy, Skills, Knowledge and Management of Dr. Rajashree Murudkar Ma'am. Hospital services were good and the staff and hygiene were great too. For insurance users, reviewing coverage early is helpful and avoids financial burden at the time of discharge. Overall a satisfying experience.

Grateful to all at Lifewave and special thankful to Dr. Rajshree Ma'am.

featured_reviews.name: Amrapali Dongre
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience with Dr Rajshree and lifewave hospital. My mother went for a cholecystectomy which required us to be admitted in the hospital for 4 days. My mother was taken care by the staff with immense care and patience. From maushi's to doctors everyone was very patient and helpful. Place is maintained very well and hygiene was immaculate. I highly recommend this hospital to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this hospital and overall had a positive experience. The staff was professional, attentive, and genuinely caring. From the reception to the nursing team, everyone ensured that the process was smooth and well-organized.

The doctors took the time to explain the diagnosis and treatment options clearly, which made me feel comfortable and informed. The facilities were clean and well-maintained, and hygiene standards seemed to be a top priority.

Overall, I would recommend this hospital for its quality care, skilled medical team, and patient-focused approach.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
My wife and I recently consulted Dr. Rajshree Murudkar for an infected cyst, and the entire experience truly exceeded our expectations. My wife was initially anxious about the surgery, but Dr. Murudkar’s reassuring demeanour and friendly approach immediately put us at ease. Her confidence and expertise made the whole procedure smooth, comfortable, and completely hassle-free.

The hospital staff were equally impressive—polite, attentive, and always ready to assist with anything we needed.

A special thanks to Ms. Gauri and the admin staff, who coordinated seamlessly with our insurance provider. We hardly had to do anything ourselves. I also genuinely appreciated how patiently she listened to all my queries and addressed each one with utmost clarity.

Overall, the entire journey was seamless and far more positive than we had expected.

Extremely grateful and would highly recommend their services 🙂🙂

featured_reviews.name: Karan Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Care & Supportive Staff

My experience at LifeWave hospital was outstanding. The doctors were knowledgeable and took time to explain everything clearly. The nurses and staff were incredibly cooperative, kind, and helpful throughout my stay. I felt genuinely cared for at every step. Thank you for making a difficult time so much easier with your professionalism and compassion. Highly recommended!
